negativeControls.name: Imported L lower-arm rotation produces a rejected backward elbow
Imported R lower-arm rotation produces a rejected backward elbow
Imported wrist gross bend is rejected in anatomical bind frame
75deg wrist twist about actual forearm is rejected independently of wrist bend
130deg distal forearm pronation is rejected without mislabelling it wrist twist
Static proximal forearm axial twist is rejected by elbow hinge frames
250mm rigid whole-character teleport is rejected without changing bone lengths

scope: Sampled imported bone positions and rotations, inverse-bind anatomical frames, and exported rigid handle anchors. Signed elbow flexion uses a hinge normal derived from bind upper-arm and forearm landmark vectors; wrist bending uses the bind forearm axis transported through the wrist, relative to the current forearm. Residual axial wrist twist is swing-twist decomposed relative to the actual distal forearm lowerarm02 and its inverse-bind neutral wrist orientation. Legitimate forearm pronation is therefore excluded from wrist twist. Contact anchors do not establish finger closure, thumb opposition or skin clearance. No shoulder scapular contact, full ROM coupling, muscle force, dynamic balance, continuous collision or garment clearance claim.
